title: C4OS Grill Question 021 - Core Tool Approval Defaults

questions.label: What should low-risk read/preview tools default to?
questions.help: Recommended: allow for trusted project reads and artifact previews, ask for outside-project reads. This preserves project trust boundaries.
options: Allow trusted project reads/previews; ask outside-project reads
Ask for all reads and previews
Deny outside-project reads with no ask path

questions.label: What should high-risk mutating tools default to?
questions.help: Recommended: ask by default for file writes/deletes, terminal commands, git/worktree mutation, networked mutation, credential use, and plugin-provided mutating tools.
options: Ask by default for all high-risk mutating tools
Deny by default for all high-risk mutating tools
Allow trusted-project file writes but ask terminal/git/network/credentials

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify specific defaults for browser.open, browser.screenshot, files.read, files.write, terminal.run, git.branch, artifact.preview, plugin tools, or remember rules.
